nodes.name: Teacher coaching’s pooled science-achievement estimate was 0.352 SD and not statistically significant.
nodes.description: The estimate uses six effect sizes from three studies with robust SE 0.242. The small evidence base makes this imprecise and the paper gives no exact p value.

nodes.name: Teacher coaching’s pooled math-achievement estimate was 0.044 SD and not statistically significant.
nodes.description: The estimate uses 20 effect sizes from five studies with robust SE 0.042. The paper gives no exact p value for this unstarred Table 2 cell.

nodes.name: Teacher coaching improved student achievement by 0.178 SD across 31 causal studies.
nodes.description: The pooled estimate uses 113 achievement effect sizes with robust SE 0.037 (p < .001). Many measures were researcher selected or aligned to coaching programs.

nodes.name: The Effect of Teacher Coaching on Instruction and Achievement: A Meta-Analysis of the Causal Evidence
nodes.description: A meta-analysis of causal evidence on teacher coaching, pooling heterogeneous programs and outcomes.

nodes.name: Teacher coaching improved instructional practice by 0.488 SD across 43 causal studies.
nodes.description: The pooled meta-analytic estimate uses 186 instructional-practice effect sizes with robust SE 0.056 (p < .001). It summarizes heterogeneous coaching programs, not one intervention.

nodes.name: Teacher coaching improved reading achievement by 0.163 SD across 26 causal studies.
nodes.description: The pooled reading estimate uses 87 effect sizes with robust SE 0.032 (p < .001). Reading dominates the achievement evidence, so it is not a general-subject estimate.

nodes.name: Districts should fund sustained teacher coaching across subjects and implementation models.
nodes.description: The meta-analysis reports positive pooled instruction and achievement estimates across its causal-study samples. Smaller math, science, and general-practice achievement subsets make a claim of uniform effects across subjects and models debatable.

nodes.name: Teacher coaching programs
nodes.description: Sustained coaching support for teachers, often combined with other professional-development components; the linked source synthesizes many distinct programs.
